topic: Bellamy turned down the Straw Hat Grand Fleet but kept a piece of Luffy's Vivre Card
title: Bellamy Turned Down Luffy But Kept One Thing
description: After Dressrosa, Bellamy refused to join Luffy's Grand Fleet but still took a piece of his Vivre Card. Here is why that small choice says more about him than the Jaya punch ever did. Is it pride or trust?
comment: Was Bellamy refusing the Grand Fleet pride or good judgment? Pick one and defend it.

lines.text: Bellamy turned down Luffy's Grand Fleet, and that is exactly why I trust him.

lines.text: But look at what he does accept: a piece of Luffy's Vivre Card, in case he ever needs it.

lines.text: It means he kept a line open to the man who flattened him in chapter 232.

lines.text: He serves nobody and keeps the door open. I think that's the first choice he makes for himself.

lines.text: So what finally pushed him to choose that way, when the Jaya punch never did?
